shellCommands.command: grep -rn "PROXY_FILE\|proxy\.ts\|MIDDLEWARE_FILE" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; grep -rn "middleware-filename\| MiddlewareFilename\|proxy-filename" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/entries.js | head -20

grep -rn "handler = mod\|mod.proxy\|mod.middleware\|middleware\b" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/index.js 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== adapter ==="; grep -rn "proxy\|middleware" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/adapter/build-complete.js 2>/dev/null | grep -i "handler\|export" | head -20

grep -rn "Named export\|must export\|export .* named\|proxy function" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/require-hook.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/entries.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/*.js 2>/dev/null | grep -v map | head -20; echo "=== docs ==="; ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -5 && timeout 180 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /workspace && (PORT=3111 npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3111/some/path | grep -i "x-request-id\|HTTP/" ; echo "--- server log ---"; grep -i "pathname" /tmp/srv.log; pkill -f "next start"
